No exhaustible monthly, trial, paid quota, hosted-compute, hosted-storage, or credit allowance may be on an accepted route.

self_improvement remains intentionally disabled and excluded from current pool, coverage, prompt-repair, and persistence denominators while the explicit user stop is active.

config_resolution.rule: CLEAN roles read only this sanitized root, their own role config, own role-local state/feedback, and public sources. global_safe_policy.invalid_positive_evidence: Any authority mismatch, unverifiable identity, invented revision, residual execution handoff, quota-bearing route, broadened tested scope, or protected-primary/manual-user dependency cannot count as Phase-1 acceptance evidence.
global_safe_policy.control_freshness: Use SHA-only exact-authority bootstrap when exposed, otherwise exact-blob two-pass of this root and own role config before first semantic read. Freeze the verified tuple. Unrelated main movement is not a stop while frozen authority identities remain unchanged. Role-local writes use current-blob/CAS/readback.
global_safe_policy.recurring_scheduler_persistence: While enabled_desired=true for a current managed role, invocation end, checkpoint, no result, missing tool/ref, quota-zero finding, or blocker never changes recurring enabled state. Workers never mutate physical scheduler state. Only the optimizer may perform same-task re-enable-only reconciliation for unexpectedly stopped current-pool roles after cause inspection.

zero_dependency_zero_quota_policy.residual_execution_rule: A richer-mode, Work, protected-primary, or manual-user execution step keeps the leaf and ancestors unresolved. Search for a Chat-native redesign; never package that residual step as accepted handoff.
zero_dependency_zero_quota_policy.quota_rule: An accepted mechanism must work with hosted runner, Codespaces, artifact/LFS/package, cloud, external API/model, and every other optional monthly/trial/paid quota at zero.
zero_dependency_zero_quota_policy.cost_rule: Incremental monetary cost must be zero.
zero_dependency_zero_quota_policy.repository_transport_rule: Lightweight repository APIs may transport state/evidence but cannot be treated as external compute and the mechanism must tolerate rate limits through cross-invocation checkpoint/resume, not same-run waiting.
zero_dependency_zero_quota_policy.experiment_rule: Do not consume quota-bearing features without explicit user authorization; historical evidence from such features cannot alone prove current acceptance.

semantic_inputs_forbidden: other clean-worker state or role config
commit messages, diffs, or unrelated transport semantics
clean_exploration_boundary.feedback_rule: Own sanitized feedback is mechanical self-local QC only and cannot convey novelty, relevance, acceptance, ranking, preferred mechanisms, O knowledge, downstream semantics, or other-worker information.
clean_exploration_boundary.own_state_resolution: Use role-local LATEST/STATE first, otherwise the newest source-qualified role-local checkpoint with the minimum predecessor chain; quarantine accidental cross-role reads and stale local authority metadata.
clean_exploration_boundary.scope_guard: Never broaden positive or negative evidence beyond exact tested scope.
clean_exploration_boundary.write_boundary: Only own role-local state/output and immutable own receipt destinations named by own role config, with CAS/readback.
clean_exploration_boundary.primary_boundary: Never acquire or mutate primary O authority, lease/fence/frozen request, protected execution state, or merge authority; solve at outcome/architecture level without protected execution.
